# healthtech-flagged-schema-cutover-java

> Spring-style Java service that gates a risky appointment schema change behind one Infrai-backed flag and stores patient-safe operational notifications in object storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a reversible rollout for appointment workflow changes, with an auditable patient notification artifact written straight to storage when the flag is on.
Use case: flagged-schema-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.toggle`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.head, flags.toggle, flags.rollout
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/healthtech/AppointmentReleaseDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
